title: Input-bit equality clauses
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine with Boolean alphabet, and let $n,s$ be natural numbers. For each input position $i<n$, form the two clauses expressing that the bit for $i$ in the first row equals the bit for $i$ in the second row; the resulting conjunctive normal form is the list of these clause pairs in increasing input-position order.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine with Boolean alphabet
